item.title: Thursday 10 AM Update, Nov 26
item.description:
The Thanksgiving ten o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 26, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather for the next 24 hours; New York declares a storm emergency as hundreds of flights are canceled, and a judge declines a longer ban on taxpayer-funded administration ads; Iran claims two more tankers hit mines near Hormuz, Ukraine strikes a Russian bomber base again, and EU leaders stay far apart on the budget; China warns of countermeasures over new tariffs as Black Friday forecasts point to records online; a report that the Pentagon weighed a wartime law over Nvidia's CEO, X adds parental controls and Neuralink wins approval for a pivotal trial; Claude rewrites Claude's own API in Rust, OpenAI tightens usage limits and New York bans AI chatbot toys; malware that hijacks your browser's management settings and European warnings about AI-agent hacking; your X feed; a deadly shooting at a Massachusetts Thanksgiving game and free holiday meals around New Hampshire; and a Maine father who fills an empty chair with a hundred guests. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Thursday Morning, Nov 26
item.description:
The Thanksgiving morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 26, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather with the full seven-day forecast; the Macy's parade is postponed for the first time ever as a coastal storm hits the East, and a judge blocks the president's second birthright citizenship order; Trump and NATO's Mark Rutte warn Russia against widening the war as missiles hit Kyiv, Germany arrests two men over a synagogue plot, and a tanker fire kills thirty-one in Cairo; markets are closed today after Wednesday's comeback; Nvidia halts server shipments to Southeast Asia and Tesla and SpaceX set up merger committees; GPT-6 designs proteins and rumors swirl about AI and encryption; FIFA confirms a breach; your X feed; Black Friday and a busy holiday weekend in southern New Hampshire; and a Thanksgiving basket repaid many times over. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Wednesday 4 PM Update, Nov 25
item.description:
The Wednesday four o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 25, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather for the next 24 hours; New Jersey declares a statewide emergency ahead of the Thanksgiving nor'easter, the debate over a proposed SNAP eligibility rule, and no ruling yet on Nidal Hasan's bid to delay his execution; Israeli judges urge prosecutors to drop the most serious charge against Netanyahu, and Iran halts two protesters' executions hours before dawn; the Dow turns higher as the Nasdaq claws back most of a four percent plunge; SpaceX and Elon Musk pledge shares to every active Trump Account, and Allstate's outage drags on; Dario Amodei pushes back on claims Anthropic would hand control to AI as Democrats call for limits; 1Password discloses a breach of customer names and emails; your X feed; what's open on Thanksgiving and the Lancers' title game; and shelter pets get their own Thanksgiving feast. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
